title: Construct missile kit: mix-and-match portions, a barrage from above, five explosions
desc: J: "I want a missile set built that will rain in from above and some explosion animations modeled for me" / "different detail portions and let me mix and match". 5 noses, 4 bodies, 5 fin sets, 4 engines, 4 trails, 5 explosions; sliders in the .blend pick the mix.

takes.name: Ogive
takes.facts: nose option: rounded ogive, dark base band, yellow-green stripe; slider nose = 1

takes.name: Sharp cone
takes.facts: nose option: long sharp cone, dark heat tip; slider nose = 2

takes.name: Blunt dome
takes.facts: nose option: short blunt radar dome; slider nose = 3

takes.name: Seeker eye
takes.facts: nose option: dark collar, glowing glass seeker dome; slider nose = 4

takes.name: Penetrator spike
takes.facts: nose option: thin dark rod with a bright point, for digging in; slider nose = 5

takes.name: Banded tube
takes.facts: body option: plain tube, two dark bands, one stripe; slider body = 1

takes.name: Conduit and panels
takes.facts: body option: panel rings, a conduit along the top, two hatches; slider body = 2

takes.name: Two-stage
takes.facts: body option: fat booster stage, taper, slim front; slider body = 3

takes.name: Carrier box
takes.facts: body option: square carrier with door seams (pairs with E4); slider body = 4

takes.name: Cruise wings
takes.facts: fins option: long straight mid wings with tipped ends + four small tail fins; slider fins = 1

takes.name: Delta fins
takes.facts: fins option: four big delta fins at the tail; slider fins = 2

takes.name: Grid fins
takes.facts: fins option: four lattice grid fins on stubs; slider fins = 3

takes.name: Canards and tail
takes.facts: fins option: small canards up front + four trapezoid tail fins; slider fins = 4

takes.name: Strakes only
takes.facts: fins option: four low strakes and a ring (ballistic); slider fins = 5

takes.name: Bell nozzle
takes.facts: engine option: flared bell with a glowing core; slider engine = 1

takes.name: Air-breather
takes.facts: engine option: belly intake scoop, boat tail, small nozzle; slider engine = 2

takes.name: Four nozzles
takes.facts: engine option: four small bells; slider engine = 3

takes.name: Petal tail
takes.facts: engine option: tapered tail with four petals; slider engine = 4

takes.name: Solid beam
takes.facts: trail option: straight tapering beam, darker core; slider trail = 1

takes.name: Pixel smoke
takes.facts: trail option: pixel puffs growing and darkening behind; slider trail = 2

takes.name: Corkscrew
takes.facts: trail option: double corkscrew; slider trail = 3

takes.name: Jagged lightning
takes.facts: trail option: jagged bolt; slider trail = 4

takes.name: Ground burst
takes.facts: explosion option: instant scorch, dome to 6 blocks in 3 ticks, shock ring to 12, 12 debris pixels; goes off at frame 10 and 80; slider explosion = 1

takes.name: Airburst and embers
takes.facts: explosion option: bursts 9 blocks up: ball to 5, flat ring to 10, 22 embers drifting down for 34 ticks; goes off at frame 10 and 80; slider explosion = 2

takes.name: Penetrator plume
takes.facts: explosion option: small entry, then 6 ticks later a 20-block plume, ring, debris; goes off at frame 10 and 80; slider explosion = 3

takes.name: Cluster carpet
takes.facts: explosion option: nine small bursts walking across 8 blocks, 1.5 ticks apart; goes off at frame 10 and 80; slider explosion = 4

takes.name: Lightning scorch
takes.facts: explosion option: four bolts flicker twice, low dome, ring to 10, wide scorch; goes off at frame 10 and 80; slider explosion = 5

takes.name: The mix (sliders)
takes.facts: whatever the sliders say: default N1 + B1 + F1 + G1 + T1; real size 6 x 0.5 blocks

takes.name: Barrage
takes.facts: 14 missiles, one every 6 ticks, 60 blocks a second, steep, into a 44-block field; explode on contact; default mix and E1; missile_size 2
